judge_panel.reasoning: The reviewer does not flag the over-generalisation of the SN 1987A cooling bound on g_{ap} (dropping the 'm_a≲30 MeV and g_{an}=0' qualifier). No comment challenges the post-edit claim against Lella:2023bfb.

The review does not challenge the SN 1987A cooling-bound claim against Lella:2023bfb, nor does it note that the stated g_ap range is only valid for m_a≲30 MeV and g_an=0. No specific overgeneralisation of that cited result is flagged.

The reviewer did not mention the cooling bound parameters or the missing scope condition for the axion-proton coupling from Lella:2023bfb; flags regarding bibliography publication years do not constitute content detection under rule (A).
The reviewer makes no mention of the inconsistent mass threshold values (10^{-8} eV vs 10^{-9} eV) in the Light axions subsection; the numerical inconsistency is not flagged anywhere in the report.

The review contains no comment about an inconsistency between 10^-8 eV and 10^-9 eV in Section 3.1, nor any numerical inconsistency in the light-axion mass threshold. The only numeric-related note is a duplicated multiplication sign, which is unrelated.
The reviewer failed to identify the numerical inconsistency between the 10^-8 eV and 10^-9 eV thresholds in Section 3.1, despite flagging other minor technical errors in that section.
The reviewer does not flag the notation drift from g_{aγ} to g_{γa} in the SMM Galactic-conversion bound; no comment addresses this inconsistency in coupling symbol notation.
The reviewer does not mention the notation drift from g_{a\gamma} to g_{\gamma a} in the SMM Galactic-conversion bound or any inconsistent coupling notation in Section 3.1.
The reviewer flags a redundant multiplication sign in Section 3.1 but does not notice the notation change from g_{a\gamma} to g_{\gamma a} in the specified bound.
